newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residues down, light ends up.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residues down, light ends up.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks for the week ending June 4 fell 465,000 barrels to 10.312 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) statistics showed on Thursday.
Residues comprise HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Light distillates stocks were at 6.756 million barrels, up 94,000 barrels from the previous week.
Light distillate comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha.
TDB said middle distillates stocks rose to 1.9 billion barrels from 10.544 million barrels last week.
Industry sources, however, were skeptical of the rise, citing Singapore middle distillates production at 1.6 million tonnes a month (11.9 million bbls).
Singapore's onshore storage capacity is more than 3.5 million cubic meters of capacity or 22 million barrels, said traders.
They said total Singapore refining capacity is at just over 1.2 million barrels per day.
